Class InterventionPanel

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
org.swarmforge.client.ui.InterventionPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class InterventionPanel extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
Intervention Panel - God Mode controls for runtime simulation manipulation. Features an overarching Scheduled Event Queue system with atomic event types, multi-selection, chronological sorting, calendar time formatting, spatial sliders (centered by default on terrain surface), relative vs absolute climate delta modifiers with duration, brood management (eggs, larvae, pupae), and direct manipulation of abiotic physical drivers, pheromones, invasions, and genetic boosts.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
